_about: Second blind page, deliberately a DIFFERENT edition and publisher from beet5-p48 (Edition Peters, Mahler 5), because edition overfit is the clef specialist's biggest risk and a second Beethoven page would not test it. The shipped pipeline reads no clef on any of these 15 staves.
method: Read off a render of the clef column with detected staff lines marked and numbered 1-5. Treble and bass from the glyph. The three C clefs were resolved by WHICH LINE the glyph's waist sits on, read against the numbered lines at 600 dpi: Fagotti line 4 (tenor), Violen line 3 (alto), Violoncelle line 4 (tenor). Each is also the conventional clef for that instrument, which corroborates but was not the basis.
